workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(api,fusion,compose): entity-risk (RBA) works on a stock Compose install. Target files: services/api/app/api/v1/endpoints/fusion.py, services/fusion/app/api/router.py, services/fusion/app/services/entity_risk.py. Verified on current `main`, exactly as reported — two independent faults, the second hidden behind the first: (Ref: https://github.com/beenuar/AiSOC/pull/1937)

workarounds.symptom: Agents context bundle never receives UEBA baselines (wrong port, no service auth, schema/entity-type mismatch)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents,ueba): context bundle reaches UEBA baselines — port, auth, vocabulary, wire shape. Target files: scripts/check_service_token_wiring.py, services/agents/app/context/bundle.py, services/ueba/app/api/routes.py. Verified on current `main`, exactly as reported: `ContextBundleBuilder._fetch_baselines` could not return a baseline on **any** deployment, and the failure was a per-entity `debug` log nobody sees. Four independent defects — fixing any one alone still returns nothing: (Ref: https://github.com/beenuar/AiSOC/pull/1935)
